title.zh: 奇异值分解、低秩近似与主成分分析

lead.en: Construct the SVD of rectangular maps, derive pseudoinverse and truncation geometry, prove reconstruction error bounds, and implement centred PCA without fitting held-out data.
lead.zh: 构造矩形映射 SVD，推导伪逆与截断几何，证明重构误差界，实现不拟合留出数据的中心化 PCA。

prerequisites.en: Module 13: symmetric spectral theorem and positive-semidefinite forms; Modules 11–12: four spaces, projections and minimum-norm least squares. Probability interpretations are deferred to Module 23.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 13：对称谱定理与半正定；模块 11–12：四空间、投影与最小范数最小二乘。概率解释留到模块 23。

en: Derive an SVD from the symmetric spectral theorem and annotate full, reduced and compact shapes.
Derive rank, four spaces, conditioning and the pseudoinverse from singular directions.
Prove Frobenius and operator-norm best-rank-k error statements.
Compute training-centred PCA scores, reconstruction and scatter eigenvalues.
Distinguish variance explained, reconstruction, scaling and prediction usefulness.
Prevent centring/component leakage and diagnose weak inverse directions.
zh: 从对称谱定理推导 SVD，标明完整、约化、紧致形状。
解释矩形旋转反射、缩放、再旋转几何。
由奇异方向推导秩、四空间、条件与伪逆。
证明弗罗贝尼乌斯与算子范数最佳秩 k 误差。
计算训练中心化 PCA 分数、重构及散布特征值。
区分解释方差、重构、尺度与预测用途。
防止中心和方向泄漏，诊断弱逆方向。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive singular directions.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并推导奇异方向。

text.en: Read SVD shape and geometry selections.
text.zh: 阅读 SVD 形状与几何选段。

text.en: Explain full, reduced and compact factors without notes.
text.zh: 不看笔记解释完整、约化与紧致因子。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and trace the rank-k error proof.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，追踪秩 k 误差证明。

text.en: Measure generated-matrix truncation error and scalar storage.
text.zh: 测生成矩阵截断误差与标量存储。

title.zh: 中心化 PCA 与训练变换

text.en: Read Sections 5–6 and separate reconstruction from prediction.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，区分重构与预测。

text.en: Fit PCA on training records and reuse its transform.
text.zh: 训练记录拟合 PCA，再复用变换。

text.en: Diagnose uncentred PCA leakage and pseudoinverse cutoffs.
text.zh: 诊断未中心化、PCA 泄漏与伪逆阈值。

text.en: Complete choices and the written PCA contract.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面 PCA 约定。

text.en: Read official SVD and pseudoinverse return conventions.
text.zh: 阅读官方 SVD 与伪逆返回约定。

text.en: Explore rank truncation and complete the exit task.
text.zh: 探索秩截断并完成结业任务。
